reviews.t: Your hair with withstand gale force winds! :)
reviews.x: I've tried many products for "extreme" hairstyles like liberty spikes and nothing comes close to the performance of Got2b Glued Blasting Freeze Spray. I've now used it exclusively for over 3 years and purchase it in multi-packs for team events.  I've spiked hair as long as 18-24 inches and, if you can find a creative way to sleep with your hair spiked so high, your style will last a few days, even if you're dancing in the wind.  Tips for use: Brush or comb hair. Depending on the desired

I've tried every spray available and this one is the only one I've found that truly holds for a day. I have very fine hair and I use multiple products to build body and style, so its pretty aggravating when I spend 20 minutes styling my hair and it falls right away. This spray has held well without making my hair stiff. At first its a little less movable but after a half hour or so my hair starts moving again, just enough to make it look bouncy, and still holds the curl/style. Love this spray!

reviews.t: Strong Hold - Which is What I Needed
reviews.x: I like this spray because you don't have to use much to hold your hair place.  Other hairsprays seem weak. Also, I like that there is no cap to remove. It's easy to transport in a suitcase without fear of it being sprayed during travel.  (Many other aerosol spray cans have caps. If the cap comes off during travel, then it may spray the contents of your suitcase. This is just a better idea and design for travel.)

I use this to apply my wigs and it gives me a great, strong hold without ruining the mesh. Not recommended for use in water, but definitely a quality product. I've bought 4 cans now because I love this spray.
I have thin, fine hair.  This product is the ONLY product I've found that gives me volume and the ability to really style my short haircut.
Love this product. Keeps my hair in place without looking stiff. Also used by my daughter for her ROTC bun! Best price out there.

I’ve been using Got 2 be glued  freeze spray to hold my wig units down in the front. And it’s honestly it a great temporary hold. But when I was able to purchase them in a bundle of 3 and save I was all for it. Great pricing and fast shipping. The only issue I had was one of the nozzles was broken in transit.

reviews.t: Great price for 3 full sized bottles
reviews.x: The hold on this product is crazy and long last lasting, the prices is great for 3 full-sized bottles. I do wish they were packaged better, 2 out of the 3 bottle nozzles were broke when I received them. But the one cap that survived can come off, so I’ll reuse that one for the other bottles.

reviews.t: I use this with the got2b glue and it's amazing!
reviews.x: Worth the buy! I use this with the got2b glue and it's amazing!
Great price; the sprays work and they were there in two days.

Literally the best freaking hairspray ever! However crafted this product is amazing! I had to get this from Amazon since my local beauty supply store can’t keep it in stock! Ever. It’s more pricey on here but worth it!! I use this for all my wigs as I follow some of the TOP hairstyles that do Cardi and Nicki Minaj hair and they use this too! I like using this over ghostbond glue (tore my edges and make me break out) loyal customer forever!

[[VIDEOID:efec400a4056fafec771a9abf746873b]] I use got2b for my drag wigs and these bottles are defective. They don't spray at all, and just leak all over. Very disappointing because this is the best hair spray out there. It could just be my order, and I requested support, but I'd be wary. If you can, buy it in a store.

I’m new to using the product but I can definitely say it’s beginner friendly. I used it for a cosplay (I’d be in it for awhile) and it took little effort to put it on/use it and no work needed afterwords. Definitely recommend
Fantastic hold. We use this for dance comps and never have to worry about stray hair! We use this exclusively now in our home. Doesn't make hair feel crunchy.
I use this for my wigs and it holds for over 2 weeks. This is after shower and everything. I don’t know how yours will but this is definitely worth the money.
If you want a very strong hold look no further. I have been using this stuff for years. It works great.
This works really well. Dries in 5 minutes or so. Good to use for lace fronts.

reviews.t: Great for hold and lace wigs
reviews.x: A little goes a long way. The gold is great.

Yes it looks like a can of wasp/bee spray, but it is an awesome hairspray!,  I gave this 4 stars because One of the 3 cans , was not full (about 1/2 full, may have been the end of the run) but it works holding your style.  Update -ONE bottle that was shorted, when I tried to use it- defective just pored out and dripped down the bottle- threw it out.

My husband and I have been using this for a very long time.  We were first buying it from Walmart until they stopped carrying the product so we started looking for it online.  Thankfully it is on Amazon.  The hairspray holds very very well and other hairsprays just can't compare, in our opinion.

reviews.t: I was not happy with any other product
reviews.x: Thank you for selling this product! They stopped selling it at target and i was wondering what was i going to do? I was not happy with any other product! This is my favorite! And it holds my hair in whatever position i want! All day! And it smells good! So so happy to have it back! Thank you!

reviews.t: Badly manufactured cans /nozzles or something wrong!
reviews.x: This is good hairspray, but on two different occasions, we have received bottles/cans that don’t work.  Went to open a new full can this past week and it simply won’t spray. I tried changing the nozzle/cap from the older bottle, nope.  Full can wasted.

This hair spray is literally as the bottle says like glue !! My daughter has really fine straight hair and this is the only spray that will hold it in place all day , she will come home from school and her hair looks as if I just did it !

I absolutely cannot survive without this hairspray!! I model, and work a full time job where I’m outside most of the time!! Between windy Photoshoots and super windy days outside, my hair will NOT budge!! Absolutely worth every penny.

reviews.t: The cans were wrapped in plastic but still freely moving, but they still work!
reviews.x: The cans had the plastic on them from the warehouse but they were still rolling around in the box unprotected as some of them are dented. Luckily the amazon worker was careful with these so the nozzles didnt break, and they all work!

claims.text: Reviewers consistently praise the strong, long-lasting hold, including for extreme styles, fine hair, wigs, and dance competitions.
Many reviewers highlight the great price and value, especially when buying multi-packs or bundles.
Several reviewers report receiving bottles with broken or defective nozzles that leak or don't spray.
Reviewers note the spray holds hair without making it feel stiff or crunchy.
Some reviewers mention fast shipping and quick delivery.
